en: The image shows a colorized vintage street scene of a European town. The street is lined with old buildings with red-tiled roofs and dormer windows. There are a few horse-drawn carts and several people walking along the street, dressed in historical clothing. Signs on the buildings include 'RESTAURANT zum WEIZHAUS', 'WURSTEREI', and 'HOTEL ZUM LANGE', as well as 'GASTHOF zum ENGEL' faintly visible. A Swiss flag is flying on one of the buildings, and there is a fountain in the foreground on the right. At the top of the image, red text reads: 'Liestal, Kasernenstrasse'. The scene appears tranquil and typical of a small Swiss town.
